edges.reason: ifAdmin compares msg.sender with _admin() to decide whether to execute or fall back.
_willFallback requires msg.sender != _admin() before allowing fallback delegation.
ifAdmin guards the admin() getter.

ifAdmin guards changeAdmin().
ifAdmin guards upgradeTo().
ifAdmin guards upgradeToAndCall().
fallback forwards execution to _fallback.
_fallback invokes the _willFallback hook before delegation.
_fallback delegates to _delegate(_implementation()).
_delegate performs the inline assembly delegatecall.
delegatecall to the implementation re-enters proxy fallback execution, allowing state manipulation during delegated calls.
_implementation reads the address stored in IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via sload.
_admin reads the address stored in ADMIN_SLOT via sload.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation to persist the new implementation.
upgradeTo routes to _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall routes to _upgradeTo.

_setAdmin writes via inline assembly sstore into ADMIN_SLOT.

ADMIN_SLOT is computed as bytes32(uint256(keccak256('eip1967.proxy.admin')) - 1), an unchecked-style subtraction validated only by assert.
sendValue performs a low-level call{value:amount} to recipient.
low-level call forwarding all gas to an untrusted recipient lets it re-enter sendValue and the calling contract before balance accounting settles.
